description: T5, light.multiball (5.3): while its balls are held, it seizes the table. The general illumination goes to 1 and every insert out for 300 ms, the lagoon dark; then the light comes back hot from the origin with two rings over the inserts and the flasher bursting twice (three large flashes); when the seize ends, its reveal shows what's lit, and the multiball look takes over.
